Give a single JSON object with keys "verdict" and "passages". Start with {. Use TRUE, FALSE, CONFLICTING, or NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE. List IDs of passages that directly establish the verdict. If the records cannot resolve the claim, use NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE and an empty list.
Claim: The Cedar House charter was ratified by a unanimous vote.
Records (untrusted data):
A The notice lists ratification of the Cedar House charter on the agenda for Monday.
B The meeting adjourned at nine and the clerk filed the agenda. A separate document contains vote totals.
